query: SELECT r.id, r.task_id, r.run_id, r.step_id, r.logical_operation_id, r.physical_attempt_id, r.invocation_id, r.invocation_generation, r.final_state, r.outcome::text AS "outcome!", r.context::text AS "context?", r.producer_id FROM central.execution_completion_receipts r JOIN central.step_attempts a ON a.workspace_id = r.workspace_id AND a.id = r.step_attempt_id AND a.task_id = r.task_id AND a.run_id = r.run_id AND a.step_id = r.step_id AND a.logical_operation_id = r.logical_operation_id AND a.physical_attempt_id = r.physical_attempt_id AND a.invocation_id = r.invocation_id AND a.invocation_generation = r.invocation_generation WHERE r.workspace_id = $1 AND r.step_attempt_id = $2
